pages.text: Place an $(l:qcraft:basics/essences)essence$(/l) in the center. Each labeled face takes a block item. The top-right and bottom-right slots must stay empty.
pages.title: Fill the Grid

pages.text: An empty face slot means Air. Use at least two different block types, counting Air. Many single-block containers and machines work as $(l:qcraft:qblocks/machines)qBlock faces$(/l).
pages.title: Program Air

pages.text: Hover the crafted qBlock to see all six labeled faces. Up and Down are vertical. North, South, West, and East are fixed world directions. Java's F3 screen shows your facing.
pages.title: Read the Result
